title: LIHGA - Gamprin evening
description:
We are a guest community at the LIHGA in Schaan. Traditionally they always organize a musical evening.

Come to Schaan for the “Gampriner Evening”!

The event begins at 8:30 p.m. with a concert by the Konkordia Gamprin music association. With a varied program, the music club ensures the right musical atmosphere.

From 10 p.m. Suzie Candell takes over the stage and impresses with her wide repertoire. This ensures the best entertainment and a good atmosphere until late in the evening.

The musical finale will be DJ Andy Kas at 11:30 p.m., who will make the LIHGA dance.

We look forward to your visit to the LIHGA in Schaan!

Princely Tattoo Parade
location:
Verkehrsfreies Städtle (Lageplan)
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
Around 800 participants in the “Princely Tattoo Parade” delight over 6,000 spectators each - with free entry.

The “Princely Tattoo Parade” has been an important part of the event since “The Princely Liechtenstein Tattoo” was held for the second time. Since 2019 it has been taking place in the traffic-free town of the Liechtenstein capital Vaduz.

The “Princely Tattoo Parade” allows visitors to enjoy high-class formations - with free admission. In addition, the “Princely Tattoo Parade” is a popular and valued platform for youth musicians, music clubs and other Liechtenstein and regional clubs to present themselves to a large audience.

In total, around 800 participants inspire the over 6,000 spectators at the “Princely Tattoo Parade”.

parade
The parade begins at 11 a.m. at the town hall in Vaduz and leads through the traffic-free town to Peter-Kaiser-Platz.

Big finale
As the grand finale of the "Princely Tattoo Parade", all participants form up on Peter-Kaiser-Platz - nestled between the government and state parliament buildings - for a joint open-air concert with brilliant, musical power.

Individual square concerts
Following the official part of the "Princely Tattoo Parade", the participating music groups will perform open-air concerts on Peter-Kaiser-Platz and at several locations in the Städtle.

Alpine descent
The cows from Alp Pradamee are expected to arrive in Städtle at around 2 p.m.

Catering
There are several drink and food stalls on Peter-Kaiser-Platz.
In addition, the 2026 Gourmet Festival with numerous top chefs will take place at the same time as the “Princely Tattoo Parade” on the town hall square. Further information can be found at https://www.genussfestival.li

title: Informed pregnant in Liechtenstein
location: LAK-Haus St. MartinDr. A. SchÃ¤dler-Str. 119492 Eschen, Balzers
description:
At our free Informed Pregnant Evenings you will receive useful information about pregnancy and birth. Our experts provide information about your rights at work, financial questions, how to find a midwife or a birth preparation course and much more. You can just go, alone, with your partner or with someone you trust. No registration is necessary.

Topics of the evening in Liechtenstein:

• The rights of pregnant women in the workplace
Maternity leave, wage entitlement, protection against dismissal, health protection, parental leave

• Financial matters relating to pregnancy and birth
Birth allowance, maternity allowance, child allowances, single parent allowance, rental contributions, economic social assistance, premium reduction, maternity daily allowance

• How midwives support women
Support during pregnancy, birth, postpartum period and breastfeeding, confidant and supporter, entitlement to midwifery services, costs and financing

• Advice for mothers and fathers
Personal advice and support in the care, development and upbringing of your child
